theme.description: High-contrast dark surfaces with warm 'heated filament' accent lighting. Inspired by dark-mode CAD/slicer software to provide a highly visual, maker-oriented marketplace.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Layered and dense for technical data, spacious and immersive for 3D model showcases.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento grids for user dashboard. Wide asymmetrical grids for product marketplace with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
spacing_and_layout.surface_treatment: Flat dark backgrounds with sharp 1px borders (#2A2A30). Use minimal border-radius (rounded-md or rounded-lg).
spacing_and_layout.headers: Crystal Glass style: bg-[#0A0A0C]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#2A2A30]. CRITICAL: Never use a fully transparent header.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp-edged. Primary buttons use #FF6B00 background with dark text. Include micro-interaction scale down on click.
components.cards: Visual-first. Large render on top, technical metadata chips (STL, Supports, Wall Thickness) overlaid or directly below. 1px solid border, no default shadow.
components.file_upload: Custom dropzone component. Dashed border (#2A2A30) that transitions to solid #FF6B00 with a subtle glow when dragging a file. Include 3D file icon.
components.search_bar: Prominent Command Palette style input for aggregated search (Thingiverse/Printables). Include keyboard shortcut hints (Cmd+K) in JetBrains Mono.
components.badges: Use highly visible tech chips. e.g. STL format tag (cyan text on dark cyan bg), Print Time tag (orange text on dark orange bg).
components.3d_viewer: Integrate React Three Fiber (R3F) for model previews. Background of the canvas should be transparent to blend with the UI. Use Drei's <Stage> for optimal lighting of the STL/OBJ.
components.dropdowns_and_menus: CRITICAL: Must have solid or heavy blurred backgrounds (bg-[#141417] or bg-[#141417]/90 backdrop-blur-md). Never use transparent backgrounds.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and border color shifts from #2A2A30 to #5C5C66. Primary CTA gets a glowing drop-shadow.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Subtle fade and slide up (Framer Motion).
motion_and_interactions.loading: Instead of a standard spinner, use an animated 'printing' progress bar or a glowing line drawing a 3D cube.

media_and_icons.icon_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight for a technical but accessible feel)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Industrial Tech color palette.
Do NOT use pure #000000; stick to the provided #0A0A0C base.
Implement the UI using pure HTML+Tailwind for high-level layouts, and Shadcn for interactive pieces (Forms, Dialogs, Menus).
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (color change + cursor-pointer).
Use standard DOM elements configured via Tailwind for the Bento grid dashboard layout.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Added to Wishlist', 'Print Job Submitted').
Stripe integration should be clean and technical, opening in a customized modal or a dedicated high-contrast checkout route.
For the 3D model viewer, if actual STL parsing is complex, build a visually accurate mock using a static image wrapped in a '3D Viewer' UI overlay with rotation control hints.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
universal_guidelines: Do not center-align the main app container. Text reads left-to-right.
Avoid AI slop: No generic centered layouts, no overused gradients, no emoji icons.
Create depth through z-index layered elements.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8, p-12) to make the UI breathe.
Do not apply global 'transition: all' rules.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
